## Interactive answers

Regular and saved Agents chats can render OpenUI answers locally alongside existing Markdown, tools, and images. The library has 30 components, including charts, tables, and forms with bound selects, sliders, and checkboxes. Inputs can drive local calculations, and state persists across navigation and reloads.

Answers use the existing model and provider; no Thesys API key is needed. Follow-up actions append to the correct desktop conversation draft without replacing unsent text or attachments. The user reviews and sends the message explicitly.

Child and team transcripts and non-clipped network snapshots also render interactive answers. Follow-up actions are disabled in those views.

OpenUI programs are treated as untrusted and subject to bounded validation. Invalid programs show a fallback with source access. Programs cannot run scripts or automatically use tools or the network.

## Browser and workflows

Browser annotation badges can now be removed on the page. List labels and composer context update with the annotations, and navigation clears the overlay. Detached parent ancestry is handled in CDP.

Workflow rows show model, thinking level, and dependencies.

## Dependencies

OpenUI packages are pinned to 1.1.1 and Zod to 3.25.76. OpenUI installation telemetry is disabled, and upstream attribution is included in the third-party notices.
